Protocol Mechanics

The 24-Hour Proof-of-Activity Engine

STAGE 01

Initial Stopped State

When a plan is activated, the core starts in STOPPED (Red) state. In accordance with blockchain fair-mining rules, 0 interest is credited upon purchase until manual activation.

STAGE 02

Active Mining (24H Timer)

User taps 'Start 24H Mining'. The central core ignites in EMERALD GREEN, broadcasting computing power to the network and starting a precise 24-hour countdown timer.

STAGE 03

Automated Settlement

Exactly at the 24:00:00 mark, the smart contract automatically credits the full daily yield to the user's withdrawable balance, returning the core to Red state ready for the next daily cycle.

⚠️

Missed Cycles Fair-Use Protocol

Miners must activate their node daily. If a user fails to tap 'Start Mining' on any day, zero (0) yield is credited for that missed day, preserving network tokenomics and reward integrity.

⏱️ Daily Engagement Discipline

Capital Efficiency

Difference-Only Plan Upgrade Architecture

Never Pay Full Price to Upgrade Your Mining Power!

Unlike legacy platforms that force users to forfeit or buy duplicate plans, Neon Mining operates a strict Single-Active Node Policy with 100% credit applied towards higher tiers.

When you decide to scale up your mining hashrate, your existing plan value is deducted from the new tier price, and you pay ONLY the net difference!
